why: Drops the top safe-area inset from the toast rail's hidden-topbar rule. On Launch and the Main Menu the topbar is display: none, so row 2 of the HUD grid starts at the display edge and nothing else pushes the rail down: the M-key mute toast would land under a Dynamic Island. Under a shown topbar the inset arrives through the bar's padding instead, which is why it appears here once and not in the base rule.
